Method of Attack: UEFI ransomware preventing devices from booting
exploiting vulnerabilities CVE-2017-3197 and CVE-2017-3198 to write malicious code to UEFI firmware
exploiting kernel and SMM mode to bypass write protection and install backdoor
Attack Vector: user-mode execution via application vulnerabilities (browser exploit, malicious Word document)
exploitation of vulnerable SMI handler to execute code in SMM mode
